SJ17-09.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 2 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if this Spirit was [advented], return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2] [Heavy Armor: Purple/Yellow/Blue]

SJ17-06.effect:

SJ17-07.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Look at the contents of the opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card, or a Spirit card with [Accel] among them.

[During Advent] [LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by destroying an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.

SJ17-05.effect:

By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

If you control any [During Advent] Spirit, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. For each "Emperor Beast" family Spirit card among them, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. Add the revealed cards to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.
